items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Charlie Duke was a good drummer... I was one of his parmars [partners]

ctx.x: I remember the name. Yeah. But I couldn't, I couldn't. Well it, it, I found the thing in the newspaper, it had quite a write up on the, on that.

Yeah, well the double feature was, that was two, two, two full, full pictures. Oh, double feature, it's like that. Yeah, two, two out pictures. Did I tell you? Incidentally, Charlie Duke was a good drummer. Yeah. I liked him. Charlie Pager, your good solid tempo. And anytime you played the good solid tempo, I liked it. You do too. That's right. I was one of his parmars. I was one of his parmars. What about Ferdinand Trombino? That's, that's another story. I never will forget Joe Loi Canna playing saxophone on…
And I was one of his parmars. I was one of his parmars. What about Ferdinand Trombino?
